verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of bulk action is Salesmate's ability to "send bulk SMS", a real one-to-many operation but limited to messaging. Nothing shows general bulk operations such as mass-editing, reassigning or deleting records. Missing for 10: bulk update/edit of records, bulk delete/reassign, bulk API endpoints, AI-driven bulk actions, documented limits, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
